page.overview:
Who is Itzak Arrat?

Captain Itzak Arrat was a 24th century Starfleet officer, commanding officer of the in the 2360s.

In 2364, Arrat received an order about the testing of the Mark 25 warp sensor from Commodore Toki of the Advanced Tech Division. (, okudagram)
